annotations.title: Check a list of my owner's email addresses

description: Check up to 1000 of your owner's own email addresses before sending ($1 for up to 100 addresses, $4 for up to 1,000, counted by different entries, from the balance; a list where no address needs the mail server costs $1, the rest credited when it completes). Each comes back valid, invalid, risky or unknown with a reason; valid only when the receiving mail server confirmed the mailbox. Nothing is ever sent to the addresses. consent "own_opt_in_contacts" is required, and only when it is true: These addresses are my owner's own contacts, who agreed to hear from my owner (opt-in). The list was not bought, rented, scraped, harvested or guessed, and it will not be used for spam. Without it the answer is consent_required with the statement. We check a list your owner already has. We never supply, find, guess, enrich or sell addresses, and we never send anything to them. The answer has check_id (status checking); call get_email_check about once a minute until completed: most answers come within a few minutes, mail servers that say "try later" are retried for up to 30 minutes. A bigger order waits for your owner's approval by email (status pending_approval); once approved the check starts by itself. Limits: 2 lists open at once per owner (email_check_busy says when to try again) and 10 lists per 24 hours. The same idempotency_key with the same list replays the first check; with another list it is refused (idempotency_key_reused); a retry without the key is a new purchase. A list that looks bought, scraped or guessed is refused (list_refused) or stopped early (the unchecked part is credited). Addresses not asked, refused by their mail server because of our server, or still "try later" after every retry are credited too (get_email_check: credits).

consent.description: Required: "own_opt_in_contacts", your statement, only when it is true.

emails.description: Your owner's own contacts, plain addresses.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse with the same list to retry safely without paying twice.

inbox_instance_id.description: One of your owner's webhook inboxes: the completion event (counts only) is written there.

label.description: Your own short name for the list (a plain name, up to 60 characters), shown to your owner in the approval email.

max_price_cents.description: The most this may cost, in US cents.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if your client cannot send it as an Authorization header; leave it out when your MCP app signed in.
